title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：typhoon　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 typhoon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the farmer ① bore the typhoon that no child in the field would have described, and he said the bearing was the whole of the autumn. The ② typhoon, meaning the storm itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed undescribed in the book; a typhoon, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ typhoon in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ typhoon at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A typhoon, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the farmer said the describing is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the typhoon was the whole of the matter, meaning the destruction and not the storm. The ⑥ typhoon, meaning the destruction and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; typhoon, he said, is either something you bear or the only word that means both a storm and a destruction. He said the destruction is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ typhoon had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ typhoon of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of describing; typhoon, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ typhoon I remember is the storm described in the almanac, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ typhoon, my mother said in 1990, is the only storm that improves by being described; every typhoon, she said, is a destruction that has agreed to look like a storm. She said the destruction was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 台风（指田垄里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 台风（指那场台风本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：bear the typhoon 熬这一场台风
D. n. 台风（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 台风之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的台风之事）
F. n. 台风（指农事历里写到、被描述的那一场）
G. n. 台风、破坏（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 破坏（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bore the typhoon that no child in the field would have described
The typhoon, meaning the storm itself and not the basket
the typhoon at the far fence
the typhoon was the whole of the matter
the typhoon had become a line in an almanac
The typhoon of the whole thing
A typhoon, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: bear the typhoon 意为“熬这一场台风”，1981 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯描述的一场台风做了一遍。
typhoon 意为“台风”，指那场台风本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被描述。
typhoon 意为“台风”，指田垄里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
typhoon 意为“台风”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
typhoon 意为“台风、破坏”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场破坏就是那件事的全部。
typhoon 意为“破坏”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场台风，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
typhoon 意为“台风”，指农事历里写到、被描述的那一场，到 1986 年这一场成了农事历里的一行。
typhoon 意为“台风之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的台风之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的描述。
typhoon 意为“台风”，我记得的是农事历里描述过的那一场，1988 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一场。
typhoon 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，台风是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的台风。
